affected_system: commercial curb, loading, delivery, and urban freight network
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased dynamic curb and loading reservation policy
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased dynamic curb and loading reservation policy
pair matched block-time policy evaluation with spillover zones with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Curb regulations, occupancy, deliveries, violations, and travel effects have consistent timestamps and locations.
Observed platform or sensor activity represents only its measured market and street coverage.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased dynamic curb and loading reservation policy.

constraints.description: The urban freight and curb operations evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: curb-management director and city freight coordinator
decision_question: Did phased reservations or dynamic curb rules reduce verified conflict and delay without shifting harm?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The urban freight and curb operations evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.decision_object: phased dynamic curb and loading reservation policy
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased dynamic curb and loading reservation policy passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: matched block-time policy evaluation with spillover zones
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in legal loading success and conflict time

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased dynamic curb and loading reservation policy, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in legal loading success and conflict time
distributional gap in change in legal loading success and conflict time
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal freight or safety effects without measuring enforcement, substitution, and spillovers.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased dynamic curb and loading reservation policy passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate dynamic curb management
transportability_risks: Delivery markets, curb law, enforcement, land use, vehicle mix, and sensor coverage differ.
Platform data may omit independent carriers and informal loading behavior.
